boss_summary: V3.1 materially repairs the predecessor's exact allowlist projection, 13-governed/8-replace/5-guard partition, dot-root policy representation, staged hash and size binding, exact typed dependency graph, executable identity continuity, declared snapshot failure handling, prepare recomputation, native architecture measurement, cleanup nonauthority, and authority nonclaims. Those repairs are real and remain reusable evidence. Qualification nevertheless fails on independently demonstrated counterexamples: the public native lease registry can mint new write/delete-open selectors; the native collector cannot measure the three exact one-component root sentinels; checker completion can precede the observations it claims to check; nonroot parents can cross volumes and governed files can alias parent identities; bounded process completeness is asserted from prefiltered rows rather than derived from a full system snapshot; prepare/publish phases lack one same-lease identity, a whole-lease bound, and interphase dual-clock skew comparison; equal-valued floats can drift across canonical continuity hashes; and the fixed-input validator can read arbitrary caller paths. The root review's honest machine-only nonclaims prevent present authority escalation but do not cure implementation defects. V3.1 is therefore preserved only as append-only rejected evidence and cannot support a component lock, reviewed release, production launcher, live measurement, or canonical action.

affirmed_v3_1_repairs.reason: The exact V3.1 bytes bind the ordered Hosea allowlist, projections, 13 governed members, eight replacement members, five guard-only members, and three sentinels.
The policy requires the dot parent identity to equal the frozen model identity. Native execution of the exact three root-sentinel shapes remains absent and is separately blocking.

The pure policy calculates an exact acyclic graph and freezes current/controller executable identity, size, and hash. Future runtime bytes remain declarative until an independently reviewed lock and sealed loader compare the loaded artifacts.
The exact policy continues to deny replacement, publication, completion, canonical execution, owner capability, and hidden-writer proof.

Native architecture comes from Windows APIs, cleanup authority is absent, metadata/cloud uncertainty is disclosed, and process observations are explicitly non-exhaustive. These honest limits do not qualify the helper.

The validator rejects duplicate keys, closes the current nested schema, checks exact identifiers and operation descriptors, and enforces the current ASCII path normalization and uniqueness rules. Test completeness and arbitrary input-path access remain open.

finding_adjudications.rationale: NativeHandleLeaseV31 publicly exposes retain and register_resource. A caller can register a fresh parent-label/leaf pair, obtain its opaque token, and route it through probe_contention to the native primitive requesting GENERIC_WRITE or DELETE. Token opacity does not establish provenance when the public caller controls token issuance. The record's no-arbitrary-caller effect claim is therefore false in substance even though the API no longer accepts a raw Path.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: The probe performs no byte write or deletion, operates under a retained parent handle, and rejects unknown tokens. These are useful reductions in risk but do not prevent an issued token from naming a caller-selected nongoverned sibling.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Make handle retention and resource registration collector-private; freeze an immutable issued-resource map before returning any lease; bind each token to one exact internally verified allowlist member identity; reject post-freeze registration before any native open; and add a no-effect negative proving the native primitive is not invoked.

finding_adjudications.rationale: The pure policy represents parent_token '.' correctly, but collect_test_only_temp_root rejects every file token with fewer than two components and only builds nonempty nested parents. The green fixture relocates sentinels beneath a synthetic directory. Consequently the native helper cannot measure the exact three one-component model-root sentinel shapes or prove their parent identity is the retained model handle.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: Nested fixture members have retained-handle continuity and the pure policy binds dot to model identity. Neither establishes executable continuity for the exact static allowlist sentinels.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Treat '.' as the sole explicit model-root parent token, map it directly to the already retained model handle and identity, reject every other empty/dot/dotdot form, and exercise the exact three one-component sentinel shapes in disposable NTFS tests.

finding_adjudications.rationale: File, sentinel, and process observations are constrained only to the outer capture. Checker start/end are also inside that capture, but the policy does not require every digest-contributing observation to occur no later than checker completion. The peer's recomputed fixture with observations at second 9 and checker completion at second 7 passes. A digest of later evidence cannot retroactively make the earlier checker attestation causal.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: Checker start is before checker end, checker digest binding is exact, and both are capture-bound. These facts are necessary but insufficient without observation-to-checker ordering.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: For both clocks, require every checked target, sentinel, process, parent, environment, and effect observation to occur in a documented checker interval and no later than checker completion; define whether pre-checker-start observations are legal; add after-checker negatives for every observation class.

finding_adjudications.rationale: The policy makes nonroot parent identities mutually distinct, but does not require their volume serials to match the frozen model volume, does not represent handle-derived descendant chains from the model root, and checks file identities for uniqueness only against other governed files. The peer's cross-volume parent and file-equals-parent identity fixtures therefore pass. Logical parent tokens are not physical rooted topology.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: The dot parent equals model identity, exact parent tokens are closed, and duplicate file identities are rejected. Those checks do not establish same-volume ancestry or directory/file disjointness.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Bind volume, workspace, model, every nonroot parent, target, and sentinel to one consistent volume identity; supply retained-handle parent-chain relations from the model root; calculate descendant closure; and reject aliasing across all root, parent, directory, target, and sentinel identity keys.

finding_adjudications.rationale: The policy receives only already classified bounded rows plus caller-supplied COMPLETE/NONE/count claims. It cannot derive the bounded set from all enumerated system rows and therefore cannot distinguish a genuinely complete capture from silent omission. Inflating system_process_count while preserving only current/controller rows passes. Honest hidden_writer_exclusion_proven false prevents authority overclaim but does not satisfy process-closure qualification.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: Every supplied bounded row is strongly checked and declared partial, inaccessible, reused, omitted, exited, ambiguous, or unclassified states fail. This closes disclosed failures only, not undisclosed row omission.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Supply the complete normalized system snapshot, enumeration API identity, terminal ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES status, exact raw count, and digest; derive the bounded-name/parent candidate set inside policy; then require opened PID/start/executable/parent evidence for every derived candidate and fail closed on every inaccessible, exited, reused, ambiguous, or unclassified row.

finding_adjudications.rationale: Each capture independently compares wall and monotonic duration, while interphase checks enforce only nondecreasing order. No shared opaque lease identity, whole-lease maximum, or wall-versus-monotonic interphase elapsed comparison is present. The peer's fixture with 3,589 wall seconds and nine monotonic seconds between phases passes, so the policy cannot claim coherent same-lease chronology.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: Per-capture chronology and phase ordering are real repairs, and opaque_lease_verified_by_pure_policy remains honestly false. The nonclaim prevents authorization but cannot qualify a machine gate that labels inconsistent chronology green.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Bind prepare and publish to one wrapper-issued opaque lease identity and boot identity; enforce a maximum from prepare capture start through publish validation; compare wall and monotonic elapsed values across every interphase interval within a documented tolerance; reject stale lease, lease substitution, boot drift, clock rollback, and clock skew.

finding_adjudications.rationale: Several integer-valued raw fields are compared with Python numeric equality rather than exact integer validation, and prepare/publish continuity compares normalized Python objects rather than canonical continuity bytes or hashes. Equal-valued floats can therefore replace integers while the prepare and publish continuity SHA-256 values differ. Value equality is not exact typed canonical continuity.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: The numeric magnitudes do not change and authorization remains false, so this is lower consequence than topology and chronology defects. It still defeats the bundle's exactness claim and typed phase continuity.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Apply strict non-boolean integer validation to every size, link count, PID, parent PID, snapshot count, ordinal, and monotonic field; freeze a closed continuity schema; compare canonical continuity bytes or SHA-256 values across phases; add integer-to-float, negative, overflow, and boolean substitution negatives.

finding_adjudications.rationale: validate_files publicly accepts three caller-supplied Path objects and reads them before establishing that they are the declared fixed files. Matching hashes authenticate bytes, not the accessed location or identity. A copy, hardlink, reparse destination, or cloud-backed alternate path can therefore be opened while the result continues to claim fixed inputs and no canonical/global target access.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: Exact expected hashes prevent content substitution and validate_objects is a useful pure injection seam. Neither makes validate_files fixed-path-only or path-honest.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Make the frozen file entry point zero-argument and internally fixed to the three reviewed paths, leaving validate_objects as the test seam. If alternate locations are intentionally supported, rename the API and report exact resolved path/identity/access scope and metadata/hydration uncertainty instead of emitting fixed-input claims.

finding_adjudications.rationale: The direct semantic and Windows successes are useful lower-grade evidence, but formal pytest remains coverage_unavailable, the full native suite was not rerun after the rename, and the tests omit the two critical native defects plus substantial root, reparse, process, and every-field allowlist negatives.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: The hashed direct policy suite passed 17 functions, the static allowlist direct suite passed 33 functions, and seven disposable Windows tests passed before the private rename. These results remain affirmative evidence but cannot be promoted to complete coverage.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Add deterministic no-effect regressions for every sustained bypass; complete root/parent substitution, ancestor reparse, access denial, process exit/reuse/partial inventory, executable ambiguity, token registration, exact sentinel, and every-field allowlist matrices; then run the formal harness against the final exact hashes.

finding_adjudications.rationale: A pure deterministic policy need not inspect its own loaded bytes, but synthetic component graph hashes cannot establish a reviewed lock or launcher. A separate trusted loader must verify the exact loaded artifact bytes against an independently reviewed acyclic graph before producing any machine-pass input.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: The external detached-digest architecture is coherent and avoids self-authentication. This permits future integration work only after the V3.2 component core itself qualifies.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: After all core repairs and fresh review, construct a real component lock from exact artifact bytes, independently review it, and use a separately sealed loader to verify every loaded component before execution.

finding_adjudications.rationale: The helper is diagnostic, non-exhaustive, and lacks production collector, transaction kernel, launcher, owner capability, or cleanup authority. It must never be reused as production provenance. Its current public registration bypass and root-sentinel mismatch additionally prevent qualification even as the reviewed V3.1 test component.
finding_adjudications.counterevidence_disposition: Retained handles, native facts, honest process nonclaims, and absence of cleanup remain useful draft evidence.
finding_adjudications.required_v3_2_repair: Repair the test surface under a newly named version for evidence use only; build any production collector as a separately named, independently reviewed component.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The V3.1 exact allowlist, 13/8/5 split, pure-policy graph, executable binding, and nonclaims materially improve V3.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: They are genuine positive evidence and should be retained without granting transitive qualification.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Opaque tokens and retained parent handles eliminate the predecessor's arbitrary-path native effect surface.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: They eliminate the raw Path parameter, but public register_resource lets the caller mint the equivalent new selector under a retained parent.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The helper is test-only and need not implement production process closure.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: It may remain lower-grade rejected evidence and must not be reused in production. Test-only scope does not excuse its public effect capability or inability to measure the exact sentinels.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Exact hashes make caller-selected file locations harmless.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Hashes authenticate content, not path identity, access scope, metadata effects, reparse targets, or cloud hydration.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Machine-only and hidden-writer nonclaims make incomplete process derivation acceptable.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The nonclaims prevent escalation but do not qualify an implementation that labels asserted completeness green.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Python numeric equality is sufficient because equal-valued floats do not change operational quantities.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The canonical continuity hashes demonstrably differ, so exact representation continuity is not established.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even after full snapshot derivation and handle-bound replacement, bounded process evidence cannot exclude every pre-opened, future, hidden, renamed, kernel, sync, ancestor-thread, or noncooperating writer, and the protocol cannot eliminate every precheck-to-rename lost update or post-readback stale-state race.

minimum_v3_2_repairs.requirement: Remove public resource registration and arbitrary retention from the returned lease. Internally issue immutable opaque tokens only for exact verified allowlist identities, seal the registry before exposure, and prove unissued/post-seal selectors fail before native open.

Execute the exact one-component root sentinels by mapping only parent_token '.' to the retained model handle. Bind one volume identity, retain and attest every parent chain from the model root, calculate descendant closure, and reject every root/parent/file identity alias.

Place all digest-contributing observations in an explicit checker interval on both clocks and require them no later than checker completion. Define pre-checker observation policy and test after-checker target, sentinel, process, parent, environment, and effect evidence.

Bind a complete normalized system enumeration with API, terminal status, count, rows, and digest; derive bounded candidates inside policy; and require opened stable identity evidence for every derived candidate while preserving strict hidden-writer dissent.

Bind prepare and publish to one opaque wrapper-issued lease and boot identity, enforce one whole-lease deadline, and compare wall/monotonic elapsed values across captures and interphase gaps within a documented tolerance.

Strictly type every integer-valued field and compare a closed canonical continuity serialization or its SHA-256 across prepare and publish. Reject float, boolean, negative, overflow, and representation substitution.
Make production file validation zero-argument and fixed-path-only, preserve object injection for tests, and accurately report every opened path class plus access-metadata and hydration uncertainty.

Add no-effect regressions for all sustained findings, exact root sentinels, root/parent/identity substitution, ancestor reparses, access denial, process exit/reuse/partial inventory, executable ambiguity, and every closed allowlist field; run formal pytest on the final exact bytes.

Keep the native fixture helper permanently test-only. After the repaired pure core qualifies, independently review separately named collector, checker, wrapper, kernel, primitive, loader, and launcher artifacts; bind a real exact acyclic component graph; and have a sealed loader verify loaded bytes.

Create newly named V3.2 artifacts and freeze new hashes. Obtain fresh blind policy and native/allowlist peers, a root technical challenge, adversarial premortem, and a separate boss ruling. No pass, component lock, release, launcher, live measurement, restart, OneDrive, prepare, publish, recovery, or canonical authority transfers from V3.1.
